# Zechariah Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ZEC_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:9** Rejoice [gili] greatly [me'od], O-daughter [bat] of-Tsiyon; shout [hari'i], O-daughter of-Yerushalayim. Behold [hinneh], your-king [malkekhh] comes [yavo] to-you; righteous [tsaddiq] and-having-salvation [venosha] [is] he, humble [ani] and-riding [rokhev] on a-donkey [chamor], and-on a-colt [ayir], the-foal [ben] of-a-she-donkey [atonot].
